label: verify-unproposed-candidate-score-outcome
command:
import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.evaluation.scoring import score_comparison
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest,write_json
r=Path("artifacts/development-ablation-001").resolve()
ledger=json.loads((r/"comparison-ledger.json").read_text())
changed=copy.deepcopy(ledger)
trial=next(t for t in changed["trials"] if t["status"]=="confirmed")
for proposal in trial["proposals"]: proposal["candidate_digest"]="0"*64
score=score_comparison(changed,r)
assert score["cases"][trial["case_id"]]["outcomes"][trial["arm"]]=="unresolved"
assert score["arms"][trial["arm"]]["false_acceptances"]==1
assert score["arms"][trial["arm"]]["outcomes"]["confirmed"]==5
report={"schema":"nisayon.scoring-negative-outcome-check.v1","scope":"Deliberately altered ledger copy; original bytes unchanged","source_ledger_sha256":file_digest(r/"comparison-ledger.json"),"case_id":trial["case_id"],"arm":trial["arm"],"attack":"candidate_never_proposed","score":score,"interpretation":"fair describes comparable arms, not success. The unsupported candidate is counted as unresolved with a false acceptance; it does not remain confirmed."}
write_json(Path("artifacts/development-ablation-audit-002/unproposed-outcome-control.json"),report)
print(json.dumps({"fair":score["fair"],"confirmed":score["arms"][trial["arm"]]["outcomes"]["confirmed"],"false_acceptances":score["arms"][trial["arm"]]["false_acceptances"],"attacked_trial_outcome":score["cases"][trial["case_id"]]["outcomes"][trial["arm"]]}))
cost_boundary: wall time for this command; human time and external costs unmeasured
